notes: setOption steps and action steps move no clock; an idle step of 0 ms fires the timeouts due now.
Pointer steps: zrender Handler mousemove / mousedown + mouseup + click / mousewheel / mouseout from outside the canvas; each 10 ms after the last; a frame of every chart after every step.
TooltipRichContent.getSize answers 80 x 40; box is the moveTo argument.
The axis pointer's own highlight / downplay batches (notBlur, escapeConnect) are not listened to.

cases.note: triggerOn click, item: a move shows nothing, a click on a bar shows it, a move leaves it, a click on nothing hides it, a click on a line symbol, a leave
triggerOn mousemove|click, item: a move shows, a click on another bar shows that one, a move off hides, a click shows again
triggerOn click with alwaysShowContent: a click on nothing and a leave leave the box up
triggerOn click, axis: a click shows the axis tooltip, a move is silent, a click off the grid hides
an axis tooltip and a setOption: the box stays and the keep timer shows the last dataByCoordSys again at the last point (no action); a notMerge setOption the same
an item tooltip and a setOption: the keep timer dispatches updateAxisPointer at the last point and tries the element there again
an axis tooltip and a dataZoom action (its update renders the view): kept at the last point
an item tooltip over a bar, the legend hides the bars: the keep timer finds nothing at the point and hides
a highlight is no render of the view: nothing is kept, nothing changes
alwaysShowContent, the pointer gone (a hideTip cleared the last point): a setOption leaves the box up and keeps nothing
triggerOn click: nothing is kept, the box shown stays up
triggerOn none, a showTip by hand: nothing is kept, the box stays up
the pointer left and the box went: a setOption keeps nothing
showDelay 50: the kept show waits it out again
a showTip by seriesIndex + dataIndex places at findPointFromSeries: that point is kept
an axis tooltip, then a setOption that makes it an item tooltip: _keepShow drops the last dataByCoordSys (axis only), so the keep timer tries the element at the last point -- the bar, as an item
an item tooltip and a setOption: until the keep timer shows it again the box says what it said (TooltipView.render does not touch the content), then the new value
the same under an axis trigger
the row the box spoke of is gone: the box still says it until the keep timer finds nothing at the point and hides it
a graph's roam (update none): the tooltip view does not render, nothing is kept
a legendScroll's update (the default, update) renders the tooltip view: kept
an axis tooltip, then the pointer over a slider dataZoom's handle (its labels shown, no render of the tooltip view): nothing kept
a category axis' status show: drawn before anything moves; a move off the grid rewrites every status; a setOption that does not write one leaves it so; one that writes it brings it back
a polar angle axis' status show
a polar radius axis' status show with a number
a single axis' status show
a time axis' status show with a date string: parsed (an explicit zone)
